rationale: Continuing arabinose fermentation (reliable substrate from turn 4). Uptake of 8 mmol/gDW/h arabinose (40 mmol C) minus growth cost (18 mmol C) yields ~22 mmol C for fermentation products: acetate, butyrate, formate, CO₂, and H₂. Arginine uptake for nitrogen and biosynthesis. Growth rate 0.55 /h is sustainable and conservative given 28 h remaining and resource constraints.
